title: Thai Chicken Tostada
description: A unique twist on traditional Mexican tostadas, this Thai-inspired dish combines the flavors of Southeast Asia with the crunch of a Mexican classic.
instructions: Cook the chicken breast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
Shred the cooked chicken and set aside.
Toast the tostadas by baking them in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce, lime juice, and chili flakes (if using).
Assemble the tostadas by spreading a spoonful of the fish sauce mixture on each tostada, followed by a spoonful of the shredded chicken.
Top each tostada with a sprinkle of cabbage and a sprinkle of cilantro.
